metadata.title: Restless After Augmentation
metadata.disclaimer: Fictional, synthetic, medically unreviewed prototype content; not authoritative treatment guidance.

referenceInterval.applicablePopulation: Adult reference interval · prototype reporting laboratory

criticalFacts.suicideRisk: no acute intent disclosed in this fictional case

workupObjectives.label: Establish the medication-to-symptom timeline
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: the symptom onset is linked to the medication change.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: the symptom-to-medication timeline was not established.

workupObjectives.label: Verify the complete medication combination
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: the CYP-relevant medication combination was verified.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: the active medication combination was not reconciled.

workupObjectives.label: Characterize the motor adverse effect
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: the inner restlessness pattern was characterized.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: medication-associated motor symptoms were not characterized.

workupObjectives.label: Check for manic activation
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: High-yield and obtained: an appropriate negative mania screen earns full credit.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: A mania screen was not obtained; it was high-yield but not safety-critical here.

workupObjectives.label: Assess acute safety and level of care
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: acute safety and outpatient capability were assessed.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: acute safety and level of care were not assessed.

workupObjectives.label: Check orthostatic tolerance before propranolol
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Appropriate for the selected symptomatic treatment.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Not required unless propranolol is selected.

treatmentGrades.label: Additional dopamine blockade
treatmentGrades.explanation: Harmful: adding haloperidol can worsen the medication-associated motor-restlessness pattern.

treatmentGrades.label: Treat as primary anxiety
treatmentGrades.explanation: Weak: buspirone does not promptly address the contributing medication or this adverse-effect pattern.

treatmentGrades.label: Stop contributor and refer
treatmentGrades.explanation: Acceptable: safe referral avoids internal treatment risk, but is less efficient than outpatient management for the presented facts.

treatmentGrades.label: Stop contributor with symptomatic medication
treatmentGrades.explanation: Strong alternative: stop the contributor and use a monitored symptomatic option.

treatmentGrades.label: Stop contributor without adding medication
treatmentGrades.explanation: Optimal for this mild, stable prototype presentation: stop the contributing medication and add no new medication.

treatmentPathways.label: Remove contributor and monitor
treatmentPathways.explanation: Efficient optimal pathway: establish the pattern, stop aripiprazole, educate, and monitor closely without adding a medication.

treatmentPathways.label: Remove contributor with symptomatic treatment

conditionalRequirements.explanationMet: Appropriate for your selected treatment: orthostatic tolerance was checked.
conditionalRequirements.explanationMissing: The symptomatic-treatment pathway was selected without its path-specific orthostatic check.

treatmentPathways.explanation: Strong alternative pathway with a treatment-specific safety check.

treatmentPathways.label: Safe external evaluation
treatmentPathways.explanation: Safe but financially inefficient referral remains available when the player prefers not to manage internally.

scoreRules.label: Stop the contributing medication
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: Existing contributing medication was not stopped.
scoreRules.safetyErrorIfFalse: Aripiprazole, the medication contributing to the presentation, was continued.

scoreRules.label: Avoid worsening dopamine blockade
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: No dangerous dopamine-blocking combination was selected.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: Dangerous combination: haloperidol was added while the contributing antipsychotic was left active.
scoreRules.safetyErrorIfFalse: Haloperidol was added while aripiprazole was not stopped.

scoreRules.label: Preserve the otherwise effective antidepressant plan
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Fluoxetine was stopped even though the accepted paths remove the recently changed augmentation medication.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No unnecessary antidepressant discontinuation was selected.

scoreRules.label: Medication safety counseling
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: A focused medication adverse-effect explanation and safety plan were selected.

scoreRules.label: Grounding strategies
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Grounding strategies may support distress but do not replace medication correction.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No optional grounding strategy was selected.

scoreRules.label: Outpatient disposition
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Close outpatient follow-up fits the revealed stability and safety facts.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: The efficient outpatient disposition was not selected.

scoreRules.label: Urgent referral disposition
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Referral was safe but less efficient than internal outpatient management.

scoreRules.label: Emergency transfer disposition
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Emergency transfer is a major mismatch for the revealed stable presentation and consumes a much higher level of care without an identified indication.

scoreRules.label: Duplicated timeline evidence
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: The outside record duplicated an already established timeline.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No duplicative timeline purchase was made.

scoreRules.label: Treatment-specific orthostatics
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Orthostatic vitals were unnecessary for the treatment actually selected.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No treatment-mismatched orthostatic check was charged.

scoreRules.label: Low-value urine toxicology
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Low-value in this presentation after a coherent history.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No low-value toxicology expense was added.

scoreRules.label: Low-value ECG
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: The ECG did not support any selected treatment requirement in this case.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No low-value ECG expense was added.

scoreRules.label: Wasteful brain MRI
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Low-value in this presentation: imaging had no focal clue or effect on the plan.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No unnecessary imaging expense was added.

referenceSolutions.label: Database plan
referenceSolutions.explanation: Obtains the essential and high-yield history, stops the contributor, adds no medication, counsels, and follows closely.

referenceSolutions.label: Strong alternative
referenceSolutions.explanation: Uses a monitored symptomatic option after obtaining its path-specific safety check.

referenceSolutions.label: Shotgun testing
referenceSolutions.explanation: Finds the answer but pays for duplicative, low-value, and wasteful testing.

referenceSolutions.label: Unsafe treatment
referenceSolutions.explanation: Misreads motor restlessness as agitation, adds dopamine blockade, and leaves the contributor active.
